title: Teaching-depth pass - make the four joint categories equally explanatory, and make playback reliable
statusReason: All four categories are now taught in the same six-beat shape with a reason of their own and a learner task, the spoken explanation is separated from the headline caption, shot length is derived from narration, the lesson starts from a learner gesture, and the film clock no longer slows down when frames are dropped. Every one of those is held by a test against the shipped content and the running build. The validated elbow, the frozen assets and the honesty system are unchanged.
